A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] '''militiagung''' was a soldier in the [[Rogoe's army|army]] of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]] during the [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] tribes in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]]. The militiagung was ordered to lead a tribes of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]] to [[Destruction of Otoh Sancture|destroy]] [[Otoh Sancture]], and after the attack encountered the [[City/Legends|cities]] leader, [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], who discovered Rogoe had been responsible for Otoh Sancture's destruction.

==Behind the scenes==
The militiagung's voice is heard in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', but the game does not specify which Gungan it is supposed to be.
